meeting.title: beehiiv weekly sync
meeting.summary: Second weekly sync with beehiiv, one week after kickoff. BigQuery connection confirmed working; Caroline to share the tailored onboarding plan Monday, Tessa to invite her analysts by Wednesday.
action_items: Caroline to share the tailored onboarding plan on Monday
Tessa to invite the two analysts to the workspace by Wednesday
key_decisions: Start modeling with the newsletter-engagement marts, not the ad-revenue data
meeting.notes: Fresh onboarding, week two. Newsletter-engagement data is the first modeling target — cleanest source they have.

transcript.speaker: Caroline
transcript.text: Hi Tessa — week two! Last week ended with the warehouse connection half done. Where did it land?

transcript.speaker: Tessa Okoye
transcript.text: Landed well. We got the BigQuery connection working on Tuesday — Quarry reads from the analytics dataset without a hitch. Mark it done.

transcript.speaker: Caroline
transcript.text: Great start. Next decision is where to begin modeling — you mentioned the newsletter-engagement data is your cleanest.

transcript.speaker: Tessa Okoye
transcript.text: By far. The ad-revenue tables are a mess of legacy columns; sends and opens are what the growth team actually asks about daily.

transcript.speaker: Caroline
transcript.text: Then we start with the newsletter-engagement marts. I'll fold that into a tailored onboarding plan and share it with you on Monday.

transcript.speaker: Tessa Okoye
transcript.text: Perfect. What do you need from us to keep pace?

transcript.speaker: Caroline
transcript.text: Mainly your analysts in the workspace early, so they learn the tool while we build rather than after.

transcript.speaker: Tessa Okoye
transcript.text: Makes sense. I'll invite our two analysts to the workspace by Wednesday — they're excited to poke around anyway.

transcript.speaker: Caroline
transcript.text: That's exactly the energy we want in week two.

transcript.speaker: Tessa Okoye
transcript.text: Longer term we'd love ad-revenue attribution out of this too — sponsorship performance and so on — but I know that's a later phase.

transcript.speaker: Caroline
transcript.text: It is, and it'll be a good one. I'll note it for the roadmap conversation, nothing to do now.

transcript.speaker: Tessa Okoye
transcript.text: Great. So plan from you Monday, invites from me by Wednesday.

transcript.speaker: Caroline
transcript.text: Exactly. Enjoy the long weekend, Tessa.

expected.notes: Ordinary weekly sync on a fresh onboarding: warehouse connection reported done (t1 → Done), dated vendor and customer tasks. The ad-revenue attribution wish is a later phase, but Caroline says 'I'll note it for the roadmap conversation', so she owns remembering it: it lands as an undated task for Caroline. Contrast with case 18, where 'thinking out loud' with nobody owning it stays out.
